data.name: Abirah
data.gender_notes: Abirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Abara', meaning 'to send' or 'to let pass'. In Islamic tradition, the name Abirah is given to a girl, symbolizing her as the one who is sent or chosen by Allah. The name Abirah carries the meaning “The One Sent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abirah usually hope their child will grow to embody the one sent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Abirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The One Sent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abirah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: أبيرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: يُشيرُ اسمُ عَبيرةَ إلى التَضَرُّعِ وَالاِبتِسَامِ، وَالعَنايةِ بِالمَرءِ وَاِحتِضَانهُ، ويَكُونُ هذا الإسمُ مِنَ الأَسَاميِ الَّتي جاءَت مُذَكَّرةً وَتَكَفُّلًا، وَيُمكِنُ أَنْ يُشيرَ إلى مُداوَمَةِ العِلمِ وَاِستِعمالهِ وَالتَعلُّمِ، وَكَذَلِكَ في التَفسيرِ السَريعِ، وَكَذَلِكَ في المَصادرِ الشَامِلةِ، وَكَذَلِكَ في المَعاليِ الَّتي جاءَت مِنَ الأَسانيِ المَذْكورةِ في كِتابِ اللهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ، وَيُشيرُ الاسمُ إلى مَرحَلَةٍ مِنَ العِلمِ وَاِحتِضَانهُ، وَكَذَلِكَ في التَفسيرِ السَريعِ

in_urdu.name: عَبيرة
